name: chess-move-coach
description: Move-by-move feedback for chess.com as a Chromium extension and a Tampermonkey userscript.

scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && powershell -NoProfile -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist | Out-Null; Compress-Archive -Force -Path extension/* -DestinationPath dist/chess-move-coach-extension.zip"
